name: Lost Seed
storyline: In the magical continent of Eden, people live under the protection of the Holy Maiden. You follow Mia, a mysterious girl who has lost her memory, as she embarks on an adventure with the foreign doctor Nord in the kingdom of Inbelia. Along the way, Mia meets Monica, a talented student at the Magic Academy, and uncovers forbidden secrets and the lost memories of the land. Player choices influence the story, leading to multiple possible endings.
summary: Lost Seed is a single-player visual novel combining RPG and dating sim elements. Featuring over 300,000 words of text and more than 30 beautifully illustrated CGs, the game immerses players in a rich narrative full of fantasy, magic, romance, and mystery. Your decisions shape Mia’s journey and the fate of her companions in a captivating story on the continent of Eden.
